build_SparseSequential_model: build a SparseSequential container with sparse conv layers and ReLU activations for 3D detection
create_SparseSequential_with_OrderedDict: create a SparseSequential model using an OrderedDict to name each sparse conv and activation layer
fused_SparseSequential_bn: fuse BatchNorm1d layers into adjacent SparseConvolution modules within a SparseSequential for inference optimization
convert_ToDense_tensor: convert a SparseConvTensor to an NCHW dense tensor using the ToDense sparse module
remove_RemoveGrid_buffer: remove the pre-allocated grid buffer from a SparseConvTensor using the RemoveGrid sparse module
